  COMMENTS MAY ALSO BE PROVIDED IN THE ZOOM MEETING USING THE RAISE HAND
  FUNCTION

  PLEASE DIAL: (213) 338-8477 / MEETING ID: 940 1454 3010
  https://longbeach-gov.zoom.us/j/94014543010

 PLEASE NOTE THE ZOOM MEETING MAY ENCOUNTER TECHNICAL DISRUPTIONS, BUT IN-
  PERSON ACCESS AND PUBLIC COMMENT WILL CONTINUE TO BE AVAILABLE IN
  ACCORDANCE WITH THE BROWN ACT

  PLEASE VIEW THE MEETING FROM YOUR COMPUTER, TABLET, OR SMARTPHONE
  VIA: HTTPS://LONGBEACH.PRIMEGOV.COM/PUBLIC/PORTAL?FROMIFRAME=TRUE

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

CHAIR REMARKS

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56351  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Equity and Human Relations
  Commission meeting of Wednesday, August 6, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-56352  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from Long Beach Peace Area
  Network regarding the proposed Civil and Human Rights Investment Screening.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-56353  Recommendation to review and approve the Equity Impact Statement, developed
  by the Ad Hoc Committee of the same name, and, if appropriate, forward
  recommendations to Mayor and City Council.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-56354  Recommendation to review and approve the Listening Sessions Framework,
  developed by the Listening Session Framing Ad Hoc Committee, including
  recommendations for the upcoming Equity and Human Relations Commission
  Listening Sessions.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-56355  Recommendation to discuss streamlining Equity and Human Relations
  Commission advocacy to Mayor and City Council on actions approved by the
  Commission, and, if appropriate, to amend the Equity and Human Relations
  Commission bylaws to authorize commissioners to advocate on behalf of the body
  for all approved actions.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  25-56356  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  25-56357  Recommendation to receive and file a monthly update from the Office of Equity.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Equity and Human Relations Commission on non-agenda items. Each
speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

6.  25-56356  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees;

  A motion was made by Commissioner Lara, seconded by Commissioner

  the Listening Session Framing Ad Hoc Committee, [2] create a Social and
  Community Context Ad Hoc Committee consisting of Commissioner Batts,
  Commissioner Butler, Commissioner Lissette Flores, Commissioner Gillette,
  Commissioner Montgomery, and Commissioner Samé-Weil, [3] dissolve the
  Environmental Justice Ad Hoc Committee, and [4] create a Emergency
  Disaster and Extreme Weather Events Preparedness Ad Hoc Committee
  consisting of Commissioner Brown, Commissioner De Leon, Commissioner
  Dockery, Commissioner Koll, and Commissioner Schultz. The
  motion carried by the following vote:
